text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Eeeh~? Tannhauser-san broke out in hives and got benched by the doctor?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Yeah... pretty sure that concoction she drank last night didn't agree with her. Plus her intense solo workouts—she overexerted herself...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Is she alright...? Ah! Why don't we visit and check on her?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Checking on her is thoughtful... However, our priority must be continuing our training~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: With limited time remaining, thoroughly conditioning ourselves for the meet is our duty~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: To cover for Matikane Tannhauser-sama, the three of us must cut our split times and build a solid cushion~.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: A huge lead... I get it! That'll take the pressure right off Tannhauser-san!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Agreed! Though seeing our joint session, the path to victory won't be easy. It's gonna be rough.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Steep or not, we walk it if a path exists. Ryan Onee-sama, please adjust our schedule.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Got it! Let's sit over there and map it out.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: (Right now, my shortcomings are obvious... I must do whatever it takes so everyone can keep up...!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: (I will claim championship victory and earn Ryan Onee-sama's praise—!)

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: 『Don't worry about the triathlon. Just focus on resting up』it says...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Tannhauser-san! We brought get-well treats!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Huh? Kita-chan? Door's unlocked, come on in~.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Pardon the intrusion while you're resting. Um, we heard you developed hives...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ah, nothing terrible! Just slight itching on my back and stomach... Once it clears, I'm heading right back to practice~.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: What a relief! So you're definitely competing!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Yup. Though missing time puts me behind~. Once recovered, gotta ramp up the volume.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Overdoing it will only backfire! The team is covering your training volume while you recuperate.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Everyone is doing that...?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: They said focusing on what's possible now matters most! They're giving 100% for your sake, Tannhauser-san!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Which is why prioritizing your recovery is your most important task.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Exactly! Well, we'll head out now! I left refreshments beside the desk!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I see... Everyone's working so hard. Then I have to contribute everything I've got too...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Not at all~. We invited you precisely because of your diligent research and daily observational habits.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: That's true...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Kh, haa, haa... Acceleration is still sluggish... One more rep...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh? Solo drills, Top Road-san?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Yes! You too, Spe-chan? Thought your team finished practicing a bit ago.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, running with the team got my heart pumping so much...! Just couldn't stop myself from running more!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Heart pumping, huh...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Even during that match, everyone surged ahead near the finish! Fighting tooth and nail to overtake each other was pure fun!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Felt like the pressure from behind pushed me forward! ...Uh, does that sound weird...?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Not at all, that's magnificent! Channeling excitement like that is wonderful, Spe-chan...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: ...Can I truly match my teammates' pace? The thought keeps driving me back onto the track...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I refuse to be left behind... that's all.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Hmm... isn't that basically the same as me, Top Road-san? We both practice because we want to be stronger.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Having rivals on your own squad you refuse to lose to... that's an incredible motivator!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I've got rivals I won't lose to either. No matter the race, I aim for first place against everyone!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Aim for first place...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, I see! You're completely right! Keeping rivals in mind isn't a flaw!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yes! Pushing each other forward is what makes rivals so precious!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Yes. ...You're absolutely right!
